hosted_endpoints.auth: Authorization: Bearer <token>; free anonymous token from GET https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token or the browser page https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect. No account, no card, no email.
hosted_endpoints.note: POST with no token returns 401 by design; that is correct protocol behaviour, not a fault. The /mcp/<server>/t/<token> ready URLs were deliberately NOT published: that page states the token is the data space and the URLs must stay private.

registry_health_recheck.answer: No. The registry keeps one row per published version; a search without version=latest returns the whole history.
evidence: search=io.github.theluckystrike/aging&limit=100 -> 8 rows, versions 0.14.0 through 0.21.0, isLatest only on 0.21.0
search=io.github.theluckystrike/aging&version=latest -> single row 0.21.0 active
registry_health_recheck.deprecated_note: All four deprecated 2026-09-02 - the naming round deliberately retiring the old short names, not a failed republish.
